svg.text: ENTERPRISE MULTI-TURN CONTEXT COMPRESSION & KV PREFIX-CACHE PRESERVATION
Stop Sliding-Window Cache Misses: K=8 Epoch Compaction + Tool Slimming Saves 89.0%
1.5M Multi-Turn Sessions/Mo (24 Turns): Tier 1 Unbounded (52K tok, $240K/mo) vs. Tier 2 FIFO Drop (12% Cache Hit!) vs. Tier 4 K=8 Epoch ($26.5K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: KV Cache Destruction & JSON Bloat
1. Per-Turn Sliding Window FIFO Drop (Tier 2: 12% KV Cache Hit!):
• Dropping `Turn_1` on Turn 11 shifts token positions of `Turn_2..10`,
invalidating 100% of the KV Prefix Cache on EVERY turn & losing
34% of initial user constraints!
2. Re-Summarizing Every Turn (Tier 3: 18% Cache Hit & +1.4s Lag):
• Mutating the rolling summary prefix on every turn breaks prompt caching
3. Raw 10K-Token Tool JSON Re-Appended 20 Times (Tier 1: $240K/mo):
• Carrying dead stack traces & REST dumps across all 24 turns
Production Failure Impact (1.5M 24-Turn Sessions/Mo):
• KV Prefix Cache Hit Rate: Drops to 12.0% under FIFO sliding window
• Turn-20 Constraint Retention: 66.0% (Tier 2) | 2,450ms TTFT (Tier 1)
• Monthly Token & GPU KV Cache TCO: $240,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: K=8 Epoch Compaction + Tool Slimming + Ledger
1. Periodic K=8 Turn Block-Aligned Epoch Compaction (89.5% Cache Hit):
• Keeps prefix `[Sys + Ledger + Epoch_Summary + Turns_1..7]` 100%
append-only for 8 consecutive turns; compacts only at epoch boundary!
2. Immediate Tool-Output JQ Slimming & Pointer Offload (-78% Tokens):
• Offloads 12K-token raw JSONs to `artifact://id` & injects only
450-token projected fields into the conversation history
3. Pinned 250-Token Structured Goal & Entity Ledger (98.4% Memory):
• Preserves Turn-1 user constraints & IDs across 40+ turns
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• KV Prefix Cache Hit Rate: 89.5% (+77.5 pts vs. FIFO Sliding Window)
• Turn-20 Constraint Retention: 98.4% | Turn-20 TTFT: 340 ms (7.2x faster)
• Monthly Total TCO: $26,500 / mo (-89.0% savings vs. Tier 1)
